record.question: Which of the following is not a part of Software Configuration Management Basics?
record.explanation: The printed page 5 says only "Version", which is an artifact designation rather than an SCM activity; identification, auditing/reviewing, and status accounting are established SCM activities. This is a tentative literal reading: if "Version" is shorthand for version control, it also belongs to SCM and the question has no defensible unique exclusion. See the IEEE Computer Society SCM overview: https://www.computer.org/resources/software-configuration-management?source=resources .
